note: Surrogate gates for brain-12 (fast-brain-12: the brain-11 recipe with the left-request over-braking, the slow 60-degree re-acceleration and the late hairpin braking fixed, distilled under the round-5 pilot: m4b + motor assist v3 from m5-brake). Measured by haltere.train.brake_gates in the measured-drone surrogate (IdentifiedSim, synthetic courses, logged Minus Two / Straw Bale states); development checks, not flight evidence. The brain-11 gate definitions are kept (configs/brain11_gates.json v1: G1-G13, G3 v1 reported only). What changed: every seeded course set is FRESH (flat/steep 7300-7307, hill 7400-7411, sim seed 37, cap seeds 9101/9102), never used in any earlier training, training evaluation or gate (the round-4b audit found that brain-11's G13 and course gates reused the training evaluation seeds 3000-3007, which are also DAgger round-3 collection seeds); thresholds that brain-11 measured against brain-08 or fast-brain-10b on the old sets are re-measured with the same definitions on the fresh sets before this freeze; G13 flies the round-5 pilot (motor assist on) and adds terrain contact seconds. New: G14 (the round-4b live windows of fast-brain-11-b-cw13: Minus Two hairpin, Straw Bale lap-1 downhill; development cases, with a sim-to-real reproduction check), G15 (the mirror images of G10/G11: capped turns and hard accelerations to the right) and G16 (the motor-assist harness hairpins, fresh parameter set, under the round-5 pilot). The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a change needs a new version and a new freeze.

G1_cap_step.note: governor-like cap steps: within X + 0.5 m/s in <= 1 s and settled excess (mean speed 1-3 s after the cap minus X) <= 0.3 m/s, from a hover and from logged cruise states (X below the logged request)

G2_sustained.note: sustained requests 2/3/3.5/4.5 m/s: |excess| <= 0.3 m/s from a hover and from logged states (steady 2-5 s), the two within 0.3 m/s of each other; rollout(S) assist-speed test: |cruise excess| <= 0.3 m/s at S = 3.5 and 4.5, -0.6..+0.3 at S = 6, at most 1 crash of 8

G3_live_swaps.note: logged request replayed from 9 logged Minus Two states: speed at +1 s within 0.5 m/s of FastMotorPD in the same plant (windows whose logged commands replay within 0.3 m/s of the live speed); plant validity; the 3.45-3.5 m/s request from slow35 8.3 s and loom 9.0 s settles at <= 3.9 m/s

G8_regressions.note: 16-course development gate: finishes >= brain-08's; steep sink shortfall <= 0.25 m/s. The view-keeping descent (branch m4-descent) was not merged (its round-4 result was not flight ready), so its terrain-contact gate does not apply to this version

G3v2_live_swaps_latency.note: G3 with the brain's structural latency allowed for (brain-11 candidates only, frozen before any of them existed; G3 v1 is kept and reported). Same 9 logged Minus Two windows, same plant-validity filter and 3.5 m/s check. The speed at +1 s must lie within 0.5 m/s of the band between FastMotorPD and FastMotorPD with 80 ms of added command delay (the brain's measured 70-90 ms output lag behind its teacher), both in the same plant. Why: the PD with +80 ms is up to 0.555 m/s off the PD in these windows (gapon-01:16.1), so v1's 0.5 m/s tolerance is below the latency floor of any brain; a deviation away from both (e.g. over-braking in a capped arch turn where the delayed PD is faster) is not excused.

checks.name: distance from the PD..PD+80ms band at +1 s

Plant validity: the logged commands open loop reproduce the live speed excess within 0.3 m/s and the lowest height within 0.1 m.

checks.name: hairpin: speed excess over the capped request

G10_capped_turns.note: held-out scripted caps during turns (45/90 deg at 1 rad/s) and climbs (+1 m/s for 1.5 s) to 3 or 4 m/s, from a hover (6 m/s cruise) and from the 6 logged brain-08 cruise states of G1: within X + 0.5 m/s in <= 1 s, mean |v_h| - X over 0.5-1.5 s after the onset <= 0.5 (not through the turn at speed), and over 1-3 s in [-0.6, 0.3] (no stall below the cap in the turn). The label teacher with +80 ms passes (worst 0.53 s, 0.15, [-0.12, 0.19]).

G11_accelerate.note: held-out scripted hard acceleration from low speed at 1 m (height loop): from a 0.5 m/s creep, or from a cap-to-0.5 m/s stop out of 5 m/s cruise, to 5 m/s at 0/30/60 deg off the heading (yaw held): height loss from the brake or go onset <= 0.4 m and 4 m/s reached within 1.5 s. The label teacher with +80 ms passes (worst 0.384 m, 0.66 s); the PD with +80 ms loses 0.6-1.0 m (latency makes this hard).

selection.rule: A candidate is selectable only if it passes every primary gate (G1, G2, G3v2, G5-G16) with its weights audit clean (only readout rows 0-2 and their biases changed against the parent). Among selectable candidates the fewest terrain contact seconds under the round-5 pilot (G13 full_pilot.overall.contact_s) win, then the lowest 16-course stick chatter (regression16). If none is selectable, none is selected; candidates are ranked by primary gates passed, then G13 contact seconds, then 16-course chatter, as a report only.

diagnostics.sim_to_real: Before this freeze the two round-4b live windows were replayed from their logged states with the logged request (brake_gates.r4b_window_tests). Hairpin: the logged commands open loop end at 3.712 m/s (live 3.768); the flown brain fast-brain-11-b-cw13 reproduces its failure (3.814 m/s at the end, capped excess 1.166 vs live 1.225). Downhill: the logged commands open loop pass 0.084 m above the live contact onset (plant valid within 0.1 m); the flown brain reproduces the contact (-0.012 m). G14 therefore carries weight as a development-case gate. The PD passes both windows (capped excess -0.107, contact margin +1.111 m, speed shortfall 0.137); fast-brain-10b and brain-08 never reach the contact onset within the window on the downhill (horizontal speed shortfall 2.19 and 2.89 m/s).
diagnostics.development_cases: The r4 windows (G9), the G3 windows and the r4b windows (G14) were looked at before this freeze. G14 is not held-out. Everything seeded (G2, G5, G6, G7, G8, G12, G13, G16) uses fresh sets; G15 is the unmeasured mirror image of G10/G11. brain-12 development screening uses other angles, bearings, heights and seeds (steep 7200-7207, hill 7210-7215, hairpins turn 55/85 x arch 10/12 x wall 2.2/2.6 seed 61, training evaluation steep 7100-7107).
diagnostics.references: Measured on this tree (m5-brain12 with m5-brake merged) before the freeze: brain-08 (regression16, evaluation8, in_course_caps, full_pilot, hairpins), fast-brain-10b (full_pilot, hairpins), FastMotorPD (capped_turns_right, accelerate_right, hairpins, full_pilot) and fast-brain-11-b-cw13 (every part). Raw reports: scratchpad m5/brain12/refs/.

reference_verdicts.note: The reference controllers under these gates (only the gates whose parts were measured; None = not measured). fast-brain-11-b-cw13 (every part) passes 6 of the 15 primary gates on the fresh sets: G1, G2, G7, G8, G9, G12. On the fresh sets it also fails G5 (in-course cap excess 0.413 > 0.4) and G6 (one descending pass > 1.5 m high; post-switch lateral 3.027 m > brain-08 + 0.3 = 3.0), which it passed on the old ones; G13 (21 terrain contacts, 33.29 s, against fast-brain-10b 14 / 21.76 s, brain-08 8 / 16.05 s, FastMotorPD 17 / 24.73 s); G14 (hairpin capped excess 1.166, downhill -0.012 m, 0.514 m/s); G15 (right turns: t_within up to 1.21 s, excess up to 0.654, settled down to -0.959 hover / -0.997 live: under-braking to the right where it over-brakes to the left); G16 (5 clean of 12 with the assist, 1 wall, 4 ceiling; 0 clean and 12 walls without it). Its right-hand hard accelerations reach 4 m/s in 0.83-1.02 s (G11's left 60 deg cases never do). fast-brain-10b passes G13 and G16 (7 clean, 0 walls with the assist; 0 clean, 11 walls without). FastMotorPD passes G15 and fails G13 (17 contacts, 24.73 s, chatter 0.0053) and G16 (2 walls; 8 clean). The 4 ceiling contacts of every motor in the hairpins are the contact-support false fire the round-4b card reports (m5-safety fixes it; not merged: not flight ready).
